item.title: Democrats Face Criminal Liability for Immigrant-Related Deaths
item.description: Critics argue that Democrats and mainstream media are quick to respond when incidents occur during immigration enforcement, but the full context is often overlooked.

item.title: Venice Biennale's 'In Minor Keys' Overwhelms with Suffering
item.description: The exhibition's focus on trauma leads to an abundance of mediocre art, according to critics.

item.title: Brown's Data Center Offensive Shapes Ohio Senate Race Against Husted
item.description: Former Senator Sherrod Brown releases a new ad criticizing Senator Jon Husted's previous support for data centers.

item.title: Biden-Appointed Judge Blocks Trump's Birthright Citizenship Order
item.description: The same judge who gave a lenient sentence to Justice Kavanaugh's would-be assassin now blocks the administration's renewed attempt to end birthright citizenship.
